description: Kannel bearerbox (vanilla / SVN / Kannel-HA) - servers, SMSC routes, SMSC links and boxes

panels.title: Gateway / build information
panels.description:
Identity of every bearerbox: product (Kannel or Kannel-HA), version, SVN or release (apt) build, build date, hostname, IP, uptime, DLR storage type and kernel.

Follows the Server filter.

targets.expr: max by (server, product, flavour, build_type, version, build, hostname, host_ip, os_release, dlr_storage) (kannel_gateway_info{server=~"$server"})

max by (server, product, flavour, build_type, version, build, hostname, host_ip, os_release, dlr_storage) (kannel_gateway_info{server=~"$server"}) * 0 + on (server) group_left () max by (server) (kannel_uptime_seconds{server=~"$server"})

panels.title: Gateway health
panels.description:
One row per bearerbox: reachability, running state, SMSC links online / total, connected boxes, MT / DLR / MO per second (bearerbox totals, 5 min), bearerbox and SMSC queues, DLRs waiting in dlr-storage for their report, store size (-1 = no store) and scrape time.

Follows the Server filter.

targets.expr: max by (server) (kannel_up{server=~"$server"})
max by (server) (sum by (server) (kannel_gateway_state{server=~"$server", state="running"}))
max by (server) (kannel_smscs_online{server=~"$server"})
max by (server) (kannel_smscs_configured{server=~"$server"})
max by (server) (sum by (server) (kannel_boxes_connected{server=~"$server"}))
max by (server) (sum by (server) (rate(kannel_sms_total{server=~"$server", direction="sent"}[5m])))
max by (server) (sum by (server) (rate(kannel_dlr_total{server=~"$server", direction="received"}[5m])))
max by (server) (sum by (server) (rate(kannel_sms_total{server=~"$server", direction="received"}[5m])))
max by (server) (sum by (server) (kannel_sms_queued{server=~"$server"}))
max by (server) (kannel_dlr_queued{server=~"$server"})
max by (server) (kannel_sms_store_size{server=~"$server"})
max by (server) (sum by (server) (kannel_smsc_queued{server=~"$server"}))
max by (server) (kannel_scrape_duration_seconds{server=~"$server"})

panels.title: Peak MT (msg/s)
panels.description:
Highest MT rate of the selected links. Peak = highest 1-minute average inside the selected time range; Current = last minute.

MT = messages Kannel sends to the operator (SMSC). DLR = delivery reports received from the operator. MO = messages received from the operator. Failed = MT the operator link could not send.

Follows the Server, SMSC-ID and Link filters.

targets.expr: max_over_time(sum (rate(kannel_smsc_sms_total{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", admin_id=~"$admin_id", direction="sent"}[1m]))[$__range:15s])

panels.title: Peak DLR in (msg/s)
panels.description:

MT = messages Kannel sends to the operator (SMSC). DLR = delivery reports received from the operator. MO = messages received from the operator. Failed = MT the operator link could not send.

targets.expr: max by (server) (max_over_time(sum by (server) (rate(kannel_smsc_sms_total{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", admin_id=~"$admin_id", direction="sent"}[1m]))[$__range:15s]))
max by (server) (max_over_time(sum by (server) (rate(kannel_smsc_dlr_total{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", admin_id=~"$admin_id", direction="received"}[1m]))[$__range:15s]))

max by (server) (sum by (server) (rate(kannel_smsc_sms_total{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", admin_id=~"$admin_id", direction="sent"}[1m])))
max by (server) (sum by (server) (rate(kannel_smsc_dlr_total{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", admin_id=~"$admin_id", direction="received"}[1m])))
max by (server) (sum by (server) (rate(kannel_smsc_sms_total{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", admin_id=~"$admin_id", direction="received"}[1m])))

targets.expr: max by (server, smsc_id) (max_over_time(sum by (server, smsc_id) (rate(kannel_smsc_sms_total{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", admin_id=~"$admin_id", direction="sent"}[1m]))[$__range:15s]))
max by (server, smsc_id) (max_over_time(sum by (server, smsc_id) (rate(kannel_smsc_dlr_total{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", admin_id=~"$admin_id", direction="received"}[1m]))[$__range:15s]))
max by (server, smsc_id) (max_over_time(sum by (server, smsc_id) (rate(kannel_smsc_sms_total{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", admin_id=~"$admin_id", direction="received"}[1m]))[$__range:15s]))
max by (server, smsc_id) (sum by (server, smsc_id) (rate(kannel_smsc_sms_total{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", admin_id=~"$admin_id", direction="sent"}[1m])))
max by (server, smsc_id) (sum by (server, smsc_id) (rate(kannel_smsc_dlr_total{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", admin_id=~"$admin_id", direction="received"}[1m])))
max by (server, smsc_id) (sum by (server, smsc_id) (rate(kannel_smsc_sms_total{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", admin_id=~"$admin_id", direction="received"}[1m])))

max by (server, smsc_id, admin_id) (max_over_time(sum by (server, smsc_id, admin_id) (rate(kannel_smsc_dlr_total{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", admin_id=~"$admin_id", direction="received"}[1m]))[$__range:15s]))

max by (server, smsc_id, admin_id) (max_over_time(sum by (server, smsc_id, admin_id) (rate(kannel_smsc_sms_total{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", admin_id=~"$admin_id", direction="received"}[1m]))[$__range:15s]))
max by (server, smsc_id, admin_id) (sum by (server, smsc_id, admin_id) (rate(kannel_smsc_sms_total{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", admin_id=~"$admin_id", direction="sent"}[1m])))
max by (server, smsc_id, admin_id) (sum by (server, smsc_id, admin_id) (rate(kannel_smsc_dlr_total{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", admin_id=~"$admin_id", direction="received"}[1m])))
max by (server, smsc_id, admin_id) (sum by (server, smsc_id, admin_id) (rate(kannel_smsc_sms_total{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", admin_id=~"$admin_id", direction="received"}[1m])))

panels.title: Servers UP
panels.description:
Bearerboxes whose status page was read successfully.

Follows the Server filter.

targets.expr: sum(kannel_up{server=~"$server"})

panels.title: Servers DOWN
panels.description:
Bearerboxes whose status page could not be read (down, timeout, wrong password).

Follows the Server filter.

targets.expr: count(kannel_up{server=~"$server"} == 0) or vector(0)

panels.title: MT rate
panels.description:
MT messages per second sent to operators.

MT = messages Kannel sends to the operator (SMSC). DLR = delivery reports received from the operator. MO = messages received from the operator. Failed = MT the operator link could not send.

Follows the Server, SMSC-ID and Link filters.

targets.expr: sum (rate(kannel_smsc_sms_total{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", admin_id=~"$admin_id", direction="sent"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: DLR rate
panels.description:
Delivery reports per second received from operators.

MT = messages Kannel sends to the operator (SMSC). DLR = delivery reports received from the operator. MO = messages received from the operator. Failed = MT the operator link could not send.

Follows the Server, SMSC-ID and Link filters.

targets.expr: sum (rate(kannel_smsc_dlr_total{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", admin_id=~"$admin_id", direction="received"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: MO rate
panels.description:
MO messages per second received from operators.

MT = messages Kannel sends to the operator (SMSC). DLR = delivery reports received from the operator. MO = messages received from the operator. Failed = MT the operator link could not send.

Follows the Server, SMSC-ID and Link filters.

targets.expr: sum (rate(kannel_smsc_sms_total{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", admin_id=~"$admin_id", direction="received"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Failed rate
panels.description:
MT messages per second that failed on the SMSC links.

Follows the Server, SMSC-ID and Link filters.

targets.expr: sum (rate(kannel_smsc_failed_total{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", admin_id=~"$admin_id"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Failure %
panels.description:
Failed / (sent + failed). Green < 2 %, orange 2-5 %, red > 5 %.

Follows the Server, SMSC-ID and Link filters.

targets.expr: 100 * sum (rate(kannel_smsc_failed_total{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", admin_id=~"$admin_id"}[$__rate_interval])) / clamp_min(sum (rate(kannel_smsc_sms_total{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", admin_id=~"$admin_id", direction="sent"}[$__rate_interval])) + sum (rate(kannel_smsc_failed_total{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", admin_id=~"$admin_id"}[$__rate_interval])), 0.0001)

panels.title: DLR ratio
panels.description:
DLRs received as % of MT sent. Low = operator reports missing or delayed.

Follows the Server, SMSC-ID and Link filters.

targets.expr: 100 * sum (rate(kannel_smsc_dlr_total{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", admin_id=~"$admin_id", direction="received"}[$__rate_interval])) / clamp_min(sum (rate(kannel_smsc_sms_total{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", admin_id=~"$admin_id", direction="sent"}[$__rate_interval])), 0.0001)

panels.title: SMSC links online
panels.description:
Links in 'online' state.

Follows the Server, SMSC-ID and Link filters.

targets.expr: sum(kannel_smsc_online{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", admin_id=~"$admin_id"})

panels.title: SMSC links NOT online
panels.description:
Links that are connecting, re-connecting, disconnected or dead.

Follows the Server, SMSC-ID and Link filters.

targets.expr: count(kannel_smsc_online{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", admin_id=~"$admin_id"} == 0) or vector(0)

panels.title: MT sent (range)
panels.description:
MT sent in the selected time range.

Follows the Server, SMSC-ID and Link filters.

targets.expr: sum(increase(kannel_smsc_sms_total{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", admin_id=~"$admin_id", direction="sent"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Failed (range)
panels.description:
MT failed in the selected time range.

Follows the Server, SMSC-ID and Link filters.

targets.expr: sum(increase(kannel_smsc_failed_total{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", admin_id=~"$admin_id"}[$__range]))

panels.title: SMSC queued
panels.description:
MT waiting to be sent on the links. Growing = operator slow or link down.

Follows the Server, SMSC-ID and Link filters.

targets.expr: sum(kannel_smsc_queued{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", admin_id=~"$admin_id"})

panels.title: Bearerbox queued
panels.description:
Messages in the bearerbox incoming/outgoing queues.

Follows the Server filter.

targets.expr: sum(kannel_sms_queued{server=~"$server"})

panels.title: DLRs waiting
panels.description:
Entries in dlr-storage waiting for their delivery report.

Follows the Server filter.

targets.expr: sum(kannel_dlr_queued{server=~"$server"})

panels.title: Boxes connected
panels.description:
smsbox / wapbox / ksmppd / smppbox connections to the bearerboxes.

Follows the Server filter.

targets.expr: sum(kannel_boxes_connected{server=~"$server"})

panels.title: Messages by kind (SMSC links)
panels.description:
MT sent, MT failed, DLR received and MO received per second.

MT = messages Kannel sends to the operator (SMSC). DLR = delivery reports received from the operator. MO = messages received from the operator. Failed = MT the operator link could not send.

Follows the Server, SMSC-ID and Link filters.

targets.expr: sum (rate(kannel_smsc_sms_total{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", admin_id=~"$admin_id", direction="sent"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum (rate(kannel_smsc_failed_total{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", admin_id=~"$admin_id"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum (rate(kannel_smsc_dlr_total{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", admin_id=~"$admin_id", direction="received"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum (rate(kannel_smsc_sms_total{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", admin_id=~"$admin_id", direction="received"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: MT per server (bearerbox)
panels.description:
MT per second from bearerbox totals, stacked per server.

Follows the Server filter.

targets.expr: sum by (server) (rate(kannel_sms_total{server=~"$server", direction="sent"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: DLR received per server (bearerbox)
panels.description:
DLRs per second from bearerbox totals.

Follows the Server filter.

targets.expr: sum by (server) (rate(kannel_dlr_total{server=~"$server", direction="received"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: MO received per server (bearerbox)
panels.description:
MO per second from bearerbox totals.

Follows the Server filter.

targets.expr: sum by (server) (rate(kannel_sms_total{server=~"$server", direction="received"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Bearerbox reported load (1 min)
panels.description:
The load Kannel computes itself over the last 60 s.

Follows the Server filter.

targets.expr: kannel_load_messages_per_second{server=~"$server", window="1m"}

panels.title: Queues & waiting DLRs
panels.description:
Bearerbox queues, SMSC queues, DLRs waiting in storage and store size over time.

Follows the Server filter.

targets.expr: sum by (server) (kannel_sms_queued{server=~"$server"})
sum by (server) (kannel_smsc_queued{server=~"$server"})
kannel_dlr_queued{server=~"$server"}
kannel_sms_store_size{server=~"$server"} >= 0

panels.title: SMSC links
panels.description:
Every SMSC connection: SMSC-ID (route), admin-id (link), SMSC username, operator host and port, state (ONLINE / RE-CONNECTING / CONNECTING / DISCONNECTED / DEAD), time in state, rates (5 min), MT / failed in range, fail %, DLR ratio, queue, how often it dropped from online in the range, and MT since the link object was created (resets on smsc restart).

MT = messages Kannel sends to the operator (SMSC). DLR = delivery reports received from the operator. MO = messages received from the operator. Failed = MT the operator link could not send.

Follows the Server, SMSC-ID and Link filters.

targets.expr: max by (server, smsc_id, admin_id, username, host, port) ((kannel_smsc_state{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", admin_id=~"$admin_id"}) * on (server, smsc_id, admin_id) group_left (username, host, port) max by (server, smsc_id, admin_id, username, host, port) (kannel_smsc_connection_info{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", admin_id=~"$admin_id"}))

max by (server, smsc_id, admin_id, username, host, port) ((time() - kannel_smsc_state_since_timestamp_seconds{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", admin_id=~"$admin_id"}) * on (server, smsc_id, admin_id) group_left (username, host, port) max by (server, smsc_id, admin_id, username, host, port) (kannel_smsc_connection_info{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", admin_id=~"$admin_id"}))

max by (server, smsc_id, admin_id, username, host, port) ((sum by (server, smsc_id, admin_id) (rate(kannel_smsc_sms_total{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", admin_id=~"$admin_id", direction="sent"}[5m]))) * on (server, smsc_id, admin_id) group_left (username, host, port) max by (server, smsc_id, admin_id, username, host, port) (kannel_smsc_connection_info{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", admin_id=~"$admin_id"}))

max by (server, smsc_id, admin_id, username, host, port) ((sum by (server, smsc_id, admin_id) (rate(kannel_smsc_dlr_total{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", admin_id=~"$admin_id", direction="received"}[5m]))) * on (server, smsc_id, admin_id) group_left (username, host, port) max by (server, smsc_id, admin_id, username, host, port) (kannel_smsc_connection_info{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", admin_id=~"$admin_id"}))

max by (server, smsc_id, admin_id, username, host, port) ((sum by (server, smsc_id, admin_id) (rate(kannel_smsc_sms_total{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", admin_id=~"$admin_id", direction="received"}[5m]))) * on (server, smsc_id, admin_id) group_left (username, host, port) max by (server, smsc_id, admin_id, username, host, port) (kannel_smsc_connection_info{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", admin_id=~"$admin_id"}))

max by (server, smsc_id, admin_id, username, host, port) ((sum by (server, smsc_id, admin_id) (increase(kannel_smsc_sms_total{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", admin_id=~"$admin_id", direction="sent"}[$__range]))) * on (server, smsc_id, admin_id) group_left (username, host, port) max by (server, smsc_id, admin_id, username, host, port) (kannel_smsc_connection_info{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", admin_id=~"$admin_id"}))

max by (server, smsc_id, admin_id, username, host, port) ((sum by (server, smsc_id, admin_id) (increase(kannel_smsc_failed_total{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", admin_id=~"$admin_id"}[$__range]))) * on (server, smsc_id, admin_id) group_left (username, host, port) max by (server, smsc_id, admin_id, username, host, port) (kannel_smsc_connection_info{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", admin_id=~"$admin_id"}))

panels.title: Top 10 SMSC-IDs by MT (range)
panels.description:
Routes with the most MT in the range.

Follows the Server, SMSC-ID and Link filters.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (server, smsc_id) (increase(kannel_smsc_sms_total{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", admin_id=~"$admin_id", direction="sent"}[$__range])))

panels.title: Top 10 SMSC-IDs by failed (range)
panels.description:
Routes with the most failed MT in the range.

Follows the Server, SMSC-ID and Link filters.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (server, smsc_id) (increase(kannel_smsc_failed_total{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", admin_id=~"$admin_id"}[$__range])) > 0)

panels.title: Top 10 failure % (range, >100 MT)
panels.description:
Worst failure % per route (routes with 100 or fewer MT hidden).

Follows the Server, SMSC-ID and Link filters.

targets.expr: topk(10, 100 * sum by (server, smsc_id) (increase(kannel_smsc_failed_total{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", admin_id=~"$admin_id"}[$__range])) / (sum by (server, smsc_id) (increase(kannel_smsc_sms_total{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", admin_id=~"$admin_id", direction="sent"}[$__range])) > 100))

panels.title: MT per SMSC-ID
panels.description:
MT per second per route (stacked).

Follows the Server, SMSC-ID and Link filters.

targets.expr: sum by (server, smsc_id) (rate(kannel_smsc_sms_total{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", admin_id=~"$admin_id", direction="sent"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0

panels.title: DLR received per SMSC-ID
panels.description:
DLRs per second per route (stacked).

Follows the Server, SMSC-ID and Link filters.

targets.expr: sum by (server, smsc_id) (rate(kannel_smsc_dlr_total{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", admin_id=~"$admin_id", direction="received"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0

panels.title: MT failed per SMSC-ID
panels.description:
Failed MT per second per route.

Follows the Server, SMSC-ID and Link filters.

targets.expr: sum by (server, smsc_id) (rate(kannel_smsc_failed_total{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", admin_id=~"$admin_id"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0

panels.title: MO received per SMSC-ID
panels.description:
MO per second per route.

Follows the Server, SMSC-ID and Link filters.

targets.expr: sum by (server, smsc_id) (rate(kannel_smsc_sms_total{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", admin_id=~"$admin_id", direction="received"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0

panels.title: Links ONLINE
panels.description:
SMSC connections in ONLINE state.

Follows the Server, SMSC-ID and Link filters.

targets.expr: count(kannel_smsc_state{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", admin_id=~"$admin_id"} == 4) or vector(0)

panels.title: Links CONNECTING / RE-CONNECTING
panels.description:
Connections trying to (re)connect to the operator.

Follows the Server, SMSC-ID and Link filters.

targets.expr: count(kannel_smsc_state{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", admin_id=~"$admin_id"} == 2 or kannel_smsc_state{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", admin_id=~"$admin_id"} == 3) or vector(0)

panels.title: Links DISCONNECTED / DEAD
panels.description:
Connections that are disconnected or dead (stopped / failed permanently).

Follows the Server, SMSC-ID and Link filters.

targets.expr: count(kannel_smsc_state{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", admin_id=~"$admin_id"} <= 1) or vector(0)

panels.title: Routes fully UP
panels.description:
SMSC-IDs (routes) whose links are all online.

Follows the Server, SMSC-ID and Link filters.

targets.expr: count((100 * sum by (server, smsc_id) (kannel_smsc_online{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", admin_id=~"$admin_id"}) / count by (server, smsc_id) (kannel_smsc_online{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", admin_id=~"$admin_id"})) == 100) or vector(0)

panels.title: Routes DEGRADED (some links down)
panels.description:
Routes where some, but not all, links are online - traffic still flows with less capacity.

Follows the Server, SMSC-ID and Link filters.

targets.expr: count((100 * sum by (server, smsc_id) (kannel_smsc_online{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", admin_id=~"$admin_id"}) / count by (server, smsc_id) (kannel_smsc_online{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", admin_id=~"$admin_id"})) < 100 and (100 * sum by (server, smsc_id) (kannel_smsc_online{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", admin_id=~"$admin_id"}) / count by (server, smsc_id) (kannel_smsc_online{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", admin_id=~"$admin_id"})) > 0) or vector(0)

panels.title: Routes DOWN (all links down)
panels.description:
Routes with no link online - MT for these routes cannot be sent.

Follows the Server, SMSC-ID and Link filters.

targets.expr: count((100 * sum by (server, smsc_id) (kannel_smsc_online{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", admin_id=~"$admin_id"}) / count by (server, smsc_id) (kannel_smsc_online{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", admin_id=~"$admin_id"})) == 0) or vector(0)

panels.title: Route availability (history)

targets.expr: 100 * sum by (server, smsc_id) (kannel_smsc_online{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", admin_id=~"$admin_id"}) / count by (server, smsc_id) (kannel_smsc_online{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", admin_id=~"$admin_id"})

panels.description:
One line per SMSC-ID: green = all links online, orange = degraded (some links down), red = no link online. Hover for the exact % of links online.

Follows the Server, SMSC-ID and Link filters.

panels.title: Links with problems in range (history)

targets.expr: kannel_smsc_state{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", admin_id=~"$admin_id"} and on (server, smsc_id, admin_id) (min_over_time(kannel_smsc_state{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", admin_id=~"$admin_id"}[$__range]) < 4)

panels.description:
Only links that were NOT online at some moment in the selected range: green ONLINE, orange RE-CONNECTING, yellow CONNECTING, red DISCONNECTED, dark red DEAD. Empty = every link stayed online. Healthy links are left out so the problem links stay readable.

Follows the Server, SMSC-ID and Link filters.

panels.title: Queued per SMSC-ID (top 10)

Follows the Server, SMSC-ID and Link filters.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (server, smsc_id) (kannel_smsc_queued{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", admin_id=~"$admin_id"}) > 0)

panels.title: DLR ratio % per SMSC-ID
panels.description:

panels.title: MT load per SMSC-ID (top 10, Kannel 1 min)

MT = messages Kannel sends to the operator (SMSC). DLR = delivery reports received from the operator. MO = messages received from the operator. Failed = MT the operator link could not send.

Follows the Server, SMSC-ID and Link filters.

targets.expr: sum by (server, username) (rate(kannel_smsc_dlr_total{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", admin_id=~"$admin_id", direction="received"}[$__rate_interval]) * on (server, smsc_id, admin_id) group_left (username, host, port) max by (server, smsc_id, admin_id, username, host, port) (kannel_smsc_connection_info{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", admin_id=~"$admin_id", username=~"$username"})) > 0

panels.title: Failure % per SMSC username
panels.description:
Failed / (sent + failed) per username, 5-minute window.

Follows the Server, SMSC-ID and Link filters.

targets.expr: 100 * sum by (server, username) (rate(kannel_smsc_failed_total{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", admin_id=~"$admin_id"}[5m]) * on (server, smsc_id, admin_id) group_left (username, host, port) max by (server, smsc_id, admin_id, username, host, port) (kannel_smsc_connection_info{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", admin_id=~"$admin_id", username=~"$username"})) / ((sum by (server, username) (rate(kannel_smsc_sms_total{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", admin_id=~"$admin_id", direction="sent"}[5m]) * on (server, smsc_id, admin_id) group_left (username, host, port) max by (server, smsc_id, admin_id, username, host, port) (kannel_smsc_connection_info{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", admin_id=~"$admin_id", username=~"$username"})) + sum by (server, username) (rate(kannel_smsc_failed_total{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", admin_id=~"$admin_id"}[5m]) * on (server, smsc_id, admin_id) group_left (username, host, port) max by (server, smsc_id, admin_id, username, host, port) (kannel_smsc_connection_info{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", admin_id=~"$admin_id", username=~"$username"}))) > 0.1)

panels.title: Availability per SMSC username (history)

targets.expr: 100 * sum by (server, username) (kannel_smsc_online{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", admin_id=~"$admin_id"} * on (server, smsc_id, admin_id) group_left (username, host, port) max by (server, smsc_id, admin_id, username, host, port) (kannel_smsc_connection_info{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", admin_id=~"$admin_id", username=~"$username"})) / sum by (server, username) ((kannel_smsc_online{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", admin_id=~"$admin_id"} * 0 + 1) * on (server, smsc_id, admin_id) group_left (username, host, port) max by (server, smsc_id, admin_id, username, host, port) (kannel_smsc_connection_info{server=~"$server", smsc_id=~"$smsc_id", admin_id=~"$admin_id", username=~"$username"}))

panels.description:
Green = all links of the username online, orange = some down, red = all down. Hover for the exact %.

Follows the Server, SMSC-ID and Link filters.

panels.title: Connected boxes
panels.description:
Boxes connected to the bearerboxes. Queue = messages waiting for the box. Kannel-HA builds also report open acks, ack buffer, per-box traffic and failed messages (empty on vanilla Kannel).

Follows the Server and Box filters.

targets.expr: max by (server, box_type, box_id) (kannel_box_online{server=~"$server", box_id=~"$box"})
max by (server, box_type, box_id) (kannel_box_uptime_seconds{server=~"$server", box_id=~"$box"})
max by (server, box_type, box_id) (kannel_box_queue{server=~"$server", box_id=~"$box"})
max by (server, box_type, box_id) (kannel_box_open_acks{server=~"$server", box_id=~"$box"})
max by (server, box_type, box_id) (kannel_box_ack_buffer{server=~"$server", box_id=~"$box"})
max by (server, box_type, box_id) (sum by (server, box_type, box_id) (rate(kannel_box_messages_total{server=~"$server", box_id=~"$box", type="sms", direction="received"}[5m])))
max by (server, box_type, box_id) (sum by (server, box_type, box_id) (rate(kannel_box_messages_total{server=~"$server", box_id=~"$box", type="dlr", direction="sent"}[5m])))
max by (server, box_type, box_id) (sum by (server, box_type, box_id) (increase(kannel_box_failed_total{server=~"$server", box_id=~"$box"}[$__range])))

panels.title: Box queue
panels.description:
Messages queued towards each box over time. Growing = box is slow or stuck.

Follows the Server and Box filters.

targets.expr: kannel_box_queue{server=~"$server", box_id=~"$box"}

panels.title: Box traffic (Kannel-HA)
panels.description:
SMS / DLR per second between bearerbox and each box (Kannel-HA only).

Follows the Server and Box filters.

targets.expr: sum by (server, box_id, type, direction) (rate(kannel_box_messages_total{server=~"$server", box_id=~"$box"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0

panels.title: Scrape duration
panels.description:
Time the exporter needs to read each status page.

Follows the Server filter.

targets.expr: kannel_scrape_duration_seconds{server=~"$server"}

panels.title: Scrape errors / min
panels.description:
Failed status page reads per minute.

Follows the Server filter.

targets.expr: 60 * rate(kannel_scrape_errors_total{server=~"$server"}[$__rate_interval])

panels.title: Seconds since last good scrape
panels.description:
Grows while a bearerbox's status page is unreachable.

Follows the Server filter.

targets.expr: time() - kannel_last_scrape_success_timestamp_seconds{server=~"$server"} and kannel_last_scrape_success_timestamp_seconds{server=~"$server"} > 0

title: Kannel - Bearerbox Monitoring
